findings.evidence: These definitions and proofs use only continuous linear maps, differentiation, and product equivalences; Mathlib/Analysis/Normed/Lp/ProdLp.lean:556 defines prodContinuousLinearEquiv without an inner product.
findings.fix: Use [NormedSpace ℝ V] for GraphStructure and Graph; introduce [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] for the energy theorems.
findings.issue: The inherited InnerProductSpace assumption unnecessarily restricts graphStructure, graphStructure_apply, graphStructure_graphStructure, contDiffOn_graphStructure, and fderiv_toLp_prodMk_I_eq_graphStructure_iff.

findings.evidence: JHolomorphic/Energy/MeanValue.lean:294–303 requires precisely these weaker hypotheses; the graph derivative is (1, ∂ₛu), so its boundary continuity needs only the stated derivative continuity.
findings.fix: State the general theorem with ContDiffOn ℝ 3 u (ball z₀ r) and ContinuousOn (fun y ↦ fderiv ℝ u y 1) (closedBall z₀ r), removing Ω and its neighborhood assumptions.
findings.issue: The mean-value theorem requires C³ regularity on an open neighborhood of the closed disc, excluding the weaker boundary regularity already supported by the underlying theorem.

summary: The graph API unnecessarily requires an inner product, and the mean-value theorem requires more boundary regularity than the underlying result.
